title: Italian Shrimp and Yorkshire Pudding
description: A unique Italian-inspired dish featuring shrimp and Yorkshire pudding, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Cook the jumbo shrimp in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, or until pink and cooked through. Set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Sprinkle the Italian seasoning over the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the Yorkshire pudding mix to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the mixture is thick and bubbly.
Add the cooked shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat with the Yorkshire pudding mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until the pudding is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
